identity.title: Real Edge Evidence, Native Admission and Secure Activation Readiness
identity.objective: One integrated evidence-to-activation engagement: obtain bounded genuine public pre-event/settlement evidence, independently validate and admit only source-qualified statistical edges, keep unsupported structural legs non-executable, verify native host/account/custody readiness and prepare owner-specific first canary without inventing calibration, funds, permission or trades.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: Karl expressly authorized the next consolidated post-PR262 WP and required all applicable mandatory skills with Ponytail lite first. Authority is for software and bounded approved public read-only evidence only after separate independent PROTECTED certification; no unilateral funding, paid-provider signup, secret handling, merge or real economic order.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert only changed code/docs from this branch to verified PR262 merge; real owner-run evidence stored outside repository stays immutable and is not deleted. No automatic rollback of wallet ledger, credentials, funds or already observed orders.

successor_boundary.next_title: Conditional owner-specific secure account, independent accepted edge and attended first canary within the same engagement; NOT an automatically mandated separate WP
forbidden_in_this_wp: No self-issued independent certificate or source edit before exact-hash independent PROTECTED readiness.
No invented calibration corpus, fake settlement, arbitrary confidence-based probability, uncalibrated live admission or trading for unsupported markets.
No raw API or wallet secret in repo/chat/prompts/log/argv; no unapproved paid provider activation, funding or withdrawal.
No account, credential, signed order or live economic mutation in CI or ordinary development; first real canary requires protected live owner-specific Stage A/OAuth/Stage B and an eligible host.
No unsafe partial, unhedged or sequential two-leg structural arbitrage trade, or claimed risk-free result.
No bypass of physical location checks, jurisdictional restrictions or venue terms; access refusal => NO_TRADE.
No silent alteration to existing USD5 first-live canary; dormant USD10 profile cannot become first-canary authority.
No loss-budget reset, double counting, unknown order reuse or budget refund on crash; kill and reconciliation remain authoritative.
No dependency/lock/workflow/security-policy/frozen older spec edit, no production deployment/service startup as part of PR.
No PR merge, generalized indefinite research, or speculative mini-WPs; complete truthful source and owner readiness checkpoint.
